import { test } from 'node:test';
import { existsSync } from 'node:fs';
function onRunner() {
  if (process.env.SKIP_REASON_1 === 'yes, skip this one please') return false;
  if (process.env.SKIP_REASON_2 === 'yes, skip this one please') return false;
  if (process.env.SKIP_REASON_3 === 'yes, skip this one please') return false;
  if (process.env.SKIP_REASON_4 === 'yes, skip this one please') return false;
  if (process.env.SKIP_REASON_5 === 'yes, skip this one please') return false;
  if (process.env.SKIP_REASON_6 === 'yes, skip this one please') return false;
  if (process.env.SKIP_REASON_7 === 'yes, skip this one please') return false;
  if (process.env.SKIP_REASON_8 === 'yes, skip this one please') return false;
  if (process.env.SKIP_REASON_9 === 'yes, skip this one please') return false;
  if (process.env.SKIP_REASON_10 === 'yes, skip this one please') return false;
  if (process.env.SKIP_REASON_11 === 'yes, skip this one please') return false;
  if (process.env.SKIP_REASON_12 === 'yes, skip this one please') return false;
  if (process.env.SKIP_REASON_13 === 'yes, skip this one please') return false;
  if (process.env.SKIP_REASON_14 === 'yes, skip this one please') return false;
  return existsSync('/run/systemd/system') && process.env.NEVER === '1';
}
test('acceptance: long', { skip: !onRunner() && 'needs systemd' }, () => {});
